title: Marine Corps Marathon Turkey Trot

sections.markdown:
Open to runners ages 10 and over, the 10K features a fast course through Marine Corps Base Quantico. The course goes through the tree-lined winding roads of Marine Corps Base Quantico and wraps back along the Potomac River.

The Turkey Trot starts and finishes at Lejeune Hall on Catlin Ave.

Turkey Trot Mile starts at 9:30 AM
Turkey Trot 10K starts at 10:00 AM

#RunWithTheMarines

[Click here for event information and registration](https://www.marinemarathon.com/event/turkey-trot/)
